No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper

guideline: Rate model predictions on a 3-index scale (bad, average, good) for correctness relative to gold annotations

changes_made.explanation: Simplified criteria to 'quality' since the scale measures overall quality of generated interpretations

overall_notes: The paper focuses on semantic interpretation generation for proper noun compounds, with clear NLG evaluation using both automatic metrics (BLEU, BLEURT, Exact Match) and human evaluation. The extraction was generally good but needed minor normalization and consolidation.
